title: CivilCalc Kit — Structural & BOQ Automation
tagline: Python toolkit for simply supported beam analysis and construction BOQ cost auditing with native Excel reports.
highlights: Analytical simply supported beam solver (point loads, UDL, moments) with SFD/BMD Excel charts
Messy construction BOQ cleaner with category rollups and >25% unit-rate anomaly flagging
Verified against textbook structural mechanics formulas via pytest
